initial_requirements: The Federal Highway Administration needs the Clarus system to collect, quality-control, and share environmental and road-condition observations from transportation networks. Transportation agencies, observation-system operators, weather-service providers, and researchers should be able to contribute or use the data. The system is intended to support safer road operations, timely responses to weather, and improved forecasting through an integrated source of surface transportation observations.
